translation:
<ins>Modified Jiajia Powder (加味交加散)</ins>
Dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍藥), raw rehmannia (生地黃), atractylodes (蒼朮), magnolia bark (厚朴), tangerine peel (陳皮), white poria (白茯苓), pinellia (半夏), notopterygium (羌活), duhuo (獨活), platycodon (桔梗), bitter orange (枳殼), peucedanum (前胡), bupleurum (柴胡), dried ginger (乾薑), cinnamon bark (肉桂), licorice (甘草)
Above, decoct with fresh ginger (生薑) and take. If there is heat, remove the dried ginger (乾薑) and cinnamon bark (肉桂). <ins>Notopterygium and Frankincense Decoction (羌活乳香湯)</ins>
Notopterygium (羌活), duhuo (獨活), chuanxiong (川芎), dang gui (當歸), red peony (赤芍藥), saposhnikovia (防風), schizonepeta (荊芥), moutan bark (丹皮), dipsacus (續斷), safflower (紅花), peach kernel (桃仁), frankincense (乳香)
Above, decoct with raw rehmannia (生地黃) and take.
